jamb_name: Office and Information Technology / Information Resource Management
olevel_requirement: Five (5) SSC credit passes in English Language, Economics and three (3) other subjects plus at least a pass in Mathematics. For NBC holders, three (3) other subjects could be from any of the following: Office Practice, Secretarial Duties, Principles of Accounts, Shorthand 80 WPM and Typewriting 35 WPM.
direct_entry: Two (2) 'A' Level passes chosen from Economics, Accounting and Business Management.
